description.value: The Lynn Canyon Ecology Centre is a nature museum and interpretive centre operated by the District of North Vancouver, situated at the gateway to Lynn Canyon Park's temperate rainforest. Visitors can explore interactive natural history exhibits, consult with park naturalists about local flora and fauna, and pick up trail maps before heading out to the famous Suspension Bridge. As the orientation hub for multiple trail loops including the Twin Falls Loop and Thirty Foot Pool Trail, it is a natural first stop for cyclists exploring North Vancouver's park network.
